name: CBADMCDJ.jcl
description:
This JCL job (CBADMCDJ) configures the CICS environment for the CardDemo application by defining all necessary CICS resources — including a program library, map sets, programs, and transactions — into a CICS System Definition (CSD) group named CARDDEMO. It uses the CICS utility DFHCSDUP to register all CardDemo application components so they can be installed and executed within the CICS region.Key Functionalities:
Defines a CICS library resource (COM2DOLL) pointing to the CardDemo load library (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB), which contains all compiled application programs.
Registers 18 CICS map sets covering all application screens: Login, Account Menu, View/Update/Deactivate Account, Card Menu, View/Update/Deactivate Card, Transaction, Transaction Report, Transaction Details, Add Transactions, Bill Pay Setup, Admin Menu, and four test program screens (PGM1–PGM4).
Registers 18 CICS programs covering all application functions: Login (COSGN00C), Account management (COACT00C, COACTVWC, COACTUPC, COACTDEC), Card management, Transaction processing (COTRN00C, COTRNVWC, COTRNVDC, COTRNATC), Bill Pay (COBIL00C), Admin Menu (COADM00C), and four test programs (COTSTP1C–COTSTP4C).
Defines CICS transactions linking programs to transaction IDs: CC00 (Login), CCAD (Admin Menu), CCDM (Admin Menu via COADM00C), CCT1–CCT4 (Test Programs 1–4).
Generates a listing of all defined resources in the CARDDEMO group to confirm successful registration.
Note: The DELETE GROUP(CARDDEMO) command is commented out, meaning existing definitions will not be removed before re-running; this must be manually uncommented if re-execution is needed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICS System Definition file (DFHCSD) is accessible in read/write mode and the CARDDEMO group is being configured for the first time or after a cleanup
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The DEFINE LIBRARY command is executed for the CARDDEMO group
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Library COM2DOLL is registered under the CARDDEMO group, pointing to AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB as the single physical location containing all CardDemo application programs

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - CardDemo Application Library Registration
rules.Rule_Description: Register the physical location of all CardDemo application programs in the CICS resource registry so that CICS can locate and load them when invoked by users.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group is being configured in CICS and the application library has been registered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: DEFINE MAPSET commands are executed for COSGN00M under the CARDDEMO group
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Login Screen (COSGN00M) is registered under the CARDDEMO group; note that this screen definition is submitted twice with the same description 'LOGIN SCREEN', resulting in a duplicate registration attempt for the same screen

rules.Rule_Description: Register the login screen layout that users see when authenticating into the CardDemo application. This screen definition appears twice in the source, creating a duplicate registration entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group is being configured in CICS
Acceptance_Criteria.When: DEFINE MAPSET commands are executed for account and card management screens
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following screens are registered under CARDDEMO serving dual purposes: Menu screen (COACT00S) is registered as both Account Menu and Card Menu; View screen (COACTVWS) is registered as both View Account and View Card; Update screen (COACTUPS) is registered as both Update Account and Update Card; Deactivate screen (COACTDES) is registered as both Deactivate Account and Deactivate Card

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Account and Card Management Shared Screens Registration
rules.Rule_Description: Register screen layouts for Account and Card management functions. Account and Card management intentionally share the same physical screen layouts, with the same screens serving both functional areas under different business contexts.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group is being configured in CICS
Acceptance_Criteria.When: DEFINE MAPSET commands are executed for transaction management screens
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following four screens are registered under CARDDEMO: Transaction Menu screen (COTRN00S), Transaction Report screen (COTRNVWS), Transaction Details screen (COTRNVDS), and Add Transactions screen (COTRNATS)

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Transaction Management Screens Registration
rules.Rule_Description: Register all screen layouts required for transaction management functions, covering transaction navigation, reporting, detail viewing, and new transaction entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group is being configured in CICS
Acceptance_Criteria.When: DEFINE MAPSET command is executed for COBIL00S
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Bill Pay Setup screen (COBIL00S) is registered under the CARDDEMO group

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Bill Payment Screen Registration
rules.Rule_Description: Register the screen layout for the bill payment setup function, enabling users to configure and initiate bill payments.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group is being configured in CICS
Acceptance_Criteria.When: DEFINE MAPSET commands are executed for administration and test screens
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following five screens are registered under CARDDEMO: Admin Menu screen (COADM00S), Test Program 1 screen (COTSTP1S), Test Program 2 screen (COTSTP2S), Test Program 3 screen (COTSTP3S), and Test Program 4 screen (COTSTP4S)

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Administration and Test Screens Registration
rules.Rule_Description: Register screen layouts for the administration menu and all four test program screens, supporting administrative operations and application testing activities.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group is being configured in CICS and the Login screen (COSGN00M) has been registered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: DEFINE PROGRAM command is executed for COSGN00C with TRANSID(CC00) under the CARDDEMO group
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Login program (COSGN00C) is registered under CARDDEMO and associated with transaction code CC00, allowing any user to launch the CardDemo login screen by entering the transaction code CC00

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Login Program Registration with Transaction Code CC00
rules.Rule_Description: Register the login program and associate it with transaction code CC00, enabling users to initiate the authentication process by entering a short transaction code.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group is being configured in CICS and account/card management screens have been registered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: DEFINE PROGRAM commands are executed for account and card management programs
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following programs are registered under CARDDEMO serving dual purposes: Main Menu program (COACT00C) serves as both Account Main Menu and Card Menu; View program (COACTVWC) serves as both View Account and View Card; Update program (COACTUPC) serves as both Update Account and Update Card; Deactivate program (COACTDEC) serves as both Deactivate Account and Deactivate Card

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Account and Card Management Shared Programs Registration
rules.Rule_Description: Register programs for Account and Card management functions. The same programs serve both Account and Card management operations, with business context determining which function is performed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group is being configured in CICS and transaction management screens have been registered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: DEFINE PROGRAM commands are executed for transaction management programs
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following four programs are registered under CARDDEMO: Transaction Menu program (COTRN00C), Transaction Report program (COTRNVWC), Transaction Details program (COTRNVDC), and Add Transactions program (COTRNATC)

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Transaction Management Programs Registration
rules.Rule_Description: Register all programs that handle transaction management business functions, covering transaction navigation, report generation, detail retrieval, and new transaction creation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group is being configured in CICS and the Bill Pay Setup screen (COBIL00S) has been registered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: DEFINE PROGRAM command is executed for COBIL00C
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Bill Pay program (COBIL00C) is registered under the CARDDEMO group, enabling bill payment processing functionality

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Bill Payment Program Registration
rules.Rule_Description: Register the program that handles bill payment processing for CardDemo users.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group is being configured in CICS and the Admin Menu screen (COADM00S) has been registered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: DEFINE PROGRAM command is executed for COADM00C with TRANSID(CCAD) and DEFINE TRANSACTION command is executed for CCDM pointing to COADM00C
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Admin Menu program (COADM00C) is registered under CARDDEMO with transaction code CCAD at the program level; additionally, a standalone transaction code CCDM is defined also pointing to COADM00C; as a result, both transaction codes CCAD and CCDM launch the same Admin Menu program

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Administration Program Registration with Dual Transaction Code Entry Points
rules.Rule_Description: Register the administration menu program and define two separate transaction codes (CCAD and CCDM) that both provide access to the same Admin Menu program, giving administrators two different entry points.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group is being configured in CICS and test screens (COTSTP1S through COTSTP4S) have been registered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: DEFINE PROGRAM and DEFINE TRANSACTION commands are executed for all four test programs
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following test programs and transaction codes are registered under CARDDEMO: Test Program 1 (COTSTP1C) with transaction code CCT1; Test Program 2 (COTSTP2C) with transaction code CCT2; Test Program 3 (COTSTP3C) with transaction code CCT3 — note the source description for COTSTP3C incorrectly reads 'PGM1 TEST' instead of 'PGM3 TEST', indicating a copy-paste error; Test Program 4 (COTSTP4C) with transaction code CCT4; standalone transaction definitions CCT1, CCT2, CCT3, and CCT4 are also created as separate entries each pointing to their respective test programs

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Test Programs Registration with Transaction Codes CCT1 through CCT4
rules.Rule_Description: Register all four test programs and their associated transaction codes, enabling testers to invoke each test program directly by entering its transaction code.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group already exists in the CICS System Definition file from a previous execution of this job
Acceptance_Criteria.When: This job needs to be re-executed to update or refresh CardDemo resource definitions
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The DELETE GROUP(CARDDEMO) command — which is currently commented out in the source — must be uncommented and placed before all DEFINE commands; this removes all previously registered CARDDEMO resources before re-registering them; if this step is skipped, duplicate definition errors will occur and the job will fail

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Re-run Cleanup Requirement Before Re-registration
rules.Rule_Description: When this job needs to be re-executed to refresh or update CardDemo resource definitions, all existing CARDDEMO definitions must be removed first to prevent duplicate definition errors.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All CARDDEMO resources have been successfully defined in the CICS System Definition file by this job
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A CICS administrator must manually execute the command CEDA INSTALL GROUP(CARDDEMO) to activate all registered resources in the live CICS environment; until this manual installation step is performed, no users can access any CardDemo transaction, screen, or program

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Post-Registration Manual Installation Requirement
rules.Rule_Description: Successful completion of this job alone does not make CardDemo available to users. A mandatory manual CICS installation step must be performed by an administrator after the job completes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CARDDEMO group is being configured in CICS
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The resource definition commands are processed by DFHCSDUP
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Internal message queues CSSD and IRDC (both of type INTRA — internal to the CICS region) are NOT registered because their DEFINE TDQUEUE commands are commented out; these features remain inactive and unavailable to the application until their definitions are explicitly uncommented and the job is re-run

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - Inactive Internal Message Queue Features
rules.Rule_Description: Two internal message queues planned for CardDemo (CSSD and IRDC) are present in the source code but deliberately disabled and will not be registered during this job execution.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All CARDDEMO resource definition commands — library, screens, programs, and transaction codes — have been processed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The LIST GROUP(CARDDEMO) command is executed as the final command in the SYSIN stream
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A complete printed inventory of all resources registered under the CARDDEMO group is generated in the SYSPRINT output report, serving as an audit trail confirming that all screens, programs, and transaction codes were successfully registered and providing a reference document for CICS administrators

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - CARDDEMO Resource Verification Report Generation
rules.Rule_Description: After all resource definitions are processed, a complete inventory report of all registered CARDDEMO resources is automatically generated for audit, verification, and administrative reference purposes.

flow_diagram_code:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: CardDemo CICS Resource Setup Job]):::start

    B[_STEP1 - DFHCSDUP - CICS Resource Definition Utility
    Register All CardDemo Application Resources
    into the CICS System Definition File
    under Group: CARDDEMO_]:::process

    C[_Define Application Library: COM2DOLL
    Link CardDemo Load Library as Source
    for All Application Programs_]:::process

    D[_Define Screen Layouts - MAPSETs
    Register 15 Screen Definitions:
    Login · Account Menu · View/Update/Deactivate Account
    Transaction Menu · Transaction Report · Transaction Details
    Add Transactions · Bill Pay · Admin Menu · Test Screens 1-4_]:::process

    E[_Define Business Programs
    Register 15 Business Logic Modules:
    Sign-On · Account Management · Transaction Management
    Bill Pay · Admin Menu · Test Programs 1-4_]:::process

    F[_Define Transaction Entry Codes
    Register User-Facing Transaction IDs:
    CCDM → Admin Menu
    CCT1 → Test Program 1
    CCT2 → Test Program 2
    CCT3 → Test Program 3
    CCT4 → Test Program 4_]:::process

    G[_List CARDDEMO Group
    Generate Printed Verification Report
    of All Defined Resources for Audit_]:::process

    H{_STEP1
    Completed
    Successfully?_}:::decision

    I([_CardDemo CICS Resources Successfully Defined
    All Screens, Programs and Transaction Codes
    Registered under CARDDEMO Group
    Next Action: CICS Admin to Install CARDDEMO Group
    using CEDA INSTALL GROUP'CARDDEMO'_]):::success

    J([_STEP1 Failed
    CICS Resource Definition Incomplete
    Review SYSPRINT Output for Error Details
    Possible Cause: Duplicate Definitions Exist
    Action: Uncomment DELETE GROUP'CARDDEMO' and Re-run_]):::error

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G
    G --> H
    H -->|Yes - RC = 0| I
    H -->|No - RC > 0| J
